defects: Replaces the specific second-isomorphism-theorem move (IsMaximal x (x ⊔ y) → e (x, x⊔y) (x⊓y, y)) with an arbitrary uninterpreted relation `moves`, so the statement no longer encodes the actual move being generated from
Drops the JordanHolderLattice typeclass and the actual `Iso` relation entirely; only assumes a plain Lattice
Represents 'intervals of a lattice' as arbitrary `Set α` rather than pairs of lattice elements (X × X) as used in the gold formalization of intervals/Iso

Changes the logical shape from 'e contains the Iso relation' (universally quantified over isomorphic pairs) to an existential construction of a minimal equivalence relation containing an arbitrary relation moves, which is a generic universal-algebra triviality unrelated to the Jordan-Hölder content

Because `moves` is a free, uninterpreted parameter, the theorem becomes a generic fact true for any relation on any type, losing all mathematical content specific to the second isomorphism theorem and lattice structure
